contribution_types.label: UNKNOWN: no contribution-type taxonomy published for NeurIPS 2025
contribution_types.scope: No official contribution-type categories were published in the captured 2025 sources; the review form is described only as a set of questions.
contribution_types.quote: Below is a description of the questions you will be asked on the review form for each paper and some guidelines on what to consider when answering these questions.

review_criteria.name: Quality
review_criteria.official_explanation: Technical soundness, support for claims, and appropriateness of methods.
review_criteria.quote: Is the submission technically sound? Are claims well supported (e.g., by theoretical analysis or experimental results)?

review_criteria.name: Clarity
review_criteria.official_explanation: Clear writing and organization; enough information for an expert to reproduce results.
review_criteria.quote: Is the submission clearly written? Is it well organized?

review_criteria.name: Significance
review_criteria.official_explanation: Impact and likely reuse of the results by the community.
review_criteria.quote: Are the results impactful for the community?

review_criteria.name: Originality
review_criteria.official_explanation: New insights or deepened understanding; novelty of method is not required.
review_criteria.quote: Does the work provide new insights, deepen understanding, or highlight important properties of existing methods?

review_criteria.name: Submission Compliance
review_criteria.official_explanation: Style and page-limit violations may lead to rejection without further review.
review_criteria.quote: Submissions that violate the NeurIPS style (e.g., by decreasing margins or font sizes) or page limits may be rejected without further review.

review_criteria.name: Reproducibility
review_criteria.official_explanation: Authors are required to complete the paper checklist covering reproducibility and transparency.
review_criteria.quote: authors are required to complete a paper checklist

mandatory_policy.statement: The main text may not exceed nine content pages, including all figures and tables.
mandatory_policy.quote: The main text of a submitted paper is limited to nine content pages , including all figures and tables.

mandatory_policy.statement: Submissions must be anonymized and free of identifying information.
mandatory_policy.quote: All submissions must be anonymized and may not contain any identifying information that may violate the double-blind reviewing policy.

mandatory_policy.statement: Authors must complete the NeurIPS paper checklist.
mandatory_policy.quote: authors are required to complete a paper checklist

mandatory_policy.statement: Substantially similar papers previously published or under parallel review may not be submitted.
mandatory_policy.quote: Submissions that are substantially similar to papers that the authors have previously published or submitted in parallel to other peer-reviewed venues with proceedings or journals may not be submitted to NeurIPS.

mandatory_policy.statement: Every author must have an up-to-date OpenReview profile by the full paper submission deadline.
mandatory_policy.quote: Anyone who plans to submit a paper as an author or a co-author will need to create (or update) their OpenReview profile by the full paper submission deadline.

recommended_practice.statement: Authors are encouraged to upload code as supplementary material.
recommended_practice.quote: We encourage authors to upload their code specifically as part of their supplementary material in order to help reviewers assess the quality of the work.

recommended_practice.statement: Reviewers are invited to use the paper checklist as a tool when preparing a review.
recommended_practice.quote: Feel free to use the NeurIPS paper checklist included in each paper as a tool when preparing your review

recommended_practice.statement: Reviewers should flag questionable papers for ethics review.
recommended_practice.quote: Make sure to flag any questionable papers for ethics review.

compliance_checks.requirement: Main text is at most nine content pages including figures and tables.
Submission uses the NeurIPS 2025 LaTeX style file.
No identifying information in the manuscript or supplementary material.
Paper checklist is included with the submission.
Accepted camera-ready papers include a funding disclosure.
No overlapping archival submission is under review elsewhere.

changes_from_prior_year.change: NeurIPS 2025 introduced a new Position Paper track alongside the main track.
NeurIPS 2025 requires all camera-ready papers to include a funding disclosure.
Material changes relative to NeurIPS 2024 could not be established.

unknown_policies.question: What changed between NeurIPS 2024 and NeurIPS 2025?
unknown_policies.reason: No NeurIPS 2024 source is cited by this profile, and no prior-year rule may be borrowed, so the comparison cannot be confirmed.

unknown_policies.reason: The 2025 CFP links a separate LLM policy page that was not captured; only the pointer is official here.

unknown_policies.reason: The 2025 CFP and Reviewer Guidelines in the captured sources do not list any contribution-type categories.
